meta.title: Through The Stardust
meta.description: We piece through the cluttered dreamscape to find the starlight that remains. Some of it is dazzling, some of it burns the fingers.

units.rawText: Fresnel, you saw that just then, right?
units.displayText: Fresnel, you saw that just then, right?

spans.text: Fresnel, you saw that just then, right?

units.rawText: No matter how far away, I would never mistake that person.
units.displayText: No matter how far away, I would never mistake that person.

units.rawText: Why... is Hubble...
units.displayText: Why... is Hubble...

spans.text: Why... is Hubble...

units.rawText: Hubble? What the hell did you just see? From what I can gather using the signals here, this Starsphere's owner...
units.displayText: Hubble? What the hell did you just see? From what I can gather using the signals here, this Starsphere's owner...

spans.text: Hubble? What the hell did you just see? From what I can gather using the signals here, this Starsphere's owner...

units.rawText: Hold on, you mean that the thing we briefly caught the signal of just then was Hubble!?
units.displayText: Hold on, you mean that the thing we briefly caught the signal of just then was Hubble!?

spans.text: Hold on, you mean that the thing we briefly caught the signal of just then was Hubble!?

units.rawText: We can't be absolutely sure of their identity, but to Fresnel and me, there's no doubt that it's her.
units.displayText: We can't be absolutely sure of their identity, but to Fresnel and me, there's no doubt that it's her.

spans.text: We can't be absolutely sure of their identity, but to Fresnel and me, there's no doubt that it's her.

units.rawText: But the state she's in is...
units.displayText: But the state she's in is...

spans.text: But the state she's in is...

units.rawText: ...We've contemplated this possibility, but...
units.displayText: ...We've contemplated this possibility, but...

spans.text: ...We've contemplated this possibility, but...

units.rawText: Antonina, the Analysis System is returning a much clearer signal. If that really is Hubble...
units.displayText: Antonina, the Analysis System is returning a much clearer signal. If that really is Hubble...

spans.text: Antonina, the Analysis System is returning a much clearer signal. If that really is Hubble...

units.rawText: Tch. That settles it.
units.displayText: Tch. That settles it.

spans.text: Tch. That settles it.

units.rawText: That's... an Entropic. Nothing more, nothing less.
units.displayText: That's... an Entropic. Nothing more, nothing less.

spans.text: That's... an Entropic. Nothing more, nothing less.

units.rawText: The same type you know. The ones with Entropic cores that can infect the outside world with Entropy—
units.displayText: The same type you know. The ones with Entropic cores that can infect the outside world with Entropy—

spans.text: The same type you know. The ones with Entropic cores that can infect the outside world with Entropy—

units.rawText: An Entropized Hubble?
units.displayText: An Entropized Hubble?

spans.text: An Entropized Hubble?

units.rawText: As you can empirically see, it's not too different from those more or less Entropized planets.
units.displayText: As you can empirically see, it's not too different from those more or less Entropized planets.

spans.text: As you can empirically see, it's not too different from those more or less Entropized planets.

units.rawText: I would wager that the shrinking of the Starsphere's radius has something to do with her awakening.
units.displayText: I would wager that the shrinking of the Starsphere's radius has something to do with her awakening.

spans.text: I would wager that the shrinking of the Starsphere's radius has something to do with her awakening.

units.rawText: The operands in the Starsphere might very well have been used to maintain her personal stability...
units.displayText: The operands in the Starsphere might very well have been used to maintain her personal stability...

spans.text: The operands in the Starsphere might very well have been used to maintain her personal stability...

units.rawText: But looking at it now, she doesn't seem to intend to take the initiative to expand. Ideally, we should first approach her, and then devise a plan to clear out this Starsphere.
units.displayText: But looking at it now, she doesn't seem to intend to take the initiative to expand. Ideally, we should first approach her, and then devise a plan to clear out this Starsphere.

spans.text: But looking at it now, she doesn't seem to intend to take the initiative to expand. Ideally, we should first approach her, and then devise a plan to clear out this Starsphere.

units.rawText: This is getting ugly...
units.displayText: This is getting ugly...

spans.text: This is getting ugly...

units.rawText: Fresnel, what are your thoughts?
units.displayText: Fresnel, what are your thoughts?

spans.text: Fresnel, what are your thoughts?

units.rawText: ...Hubble's still alive.
units.displayText: ...Hubble's still alive.

spans.text: ...Hubble's still alive.

units.rawText: Fresnel's voice is remarkably calm. Her sight burns into me, as if there was nothing in the whole wide world that could turn her away.
units.displayText: Fresnel's voice is remarkably calm. Her sight burns into me, as if there was nothing in the whole wide world that could turn her away.

spans.text: Fresnel's voice is remarkably calm. Her sight burns into me, as if there was nothing in the whole wide world that could turn her away.

units.rawText: Hubble hasn't sacrificed herself... she's still alive.
units.displayText: Hubble hasn't sacrificed herself... she's still alive.

spans.text: Hubble hasn't sacrificed herself... she's still alive.

units.rawText: After being devoured by that Entropized space, she must've held onto her will.
units.displayText: After being devoured by that Entropized space, she must've held onto her will.

spans.text: After being devoured by that Entropized space, she must've held onto her will.

units.rawText: I don't know the principles under which this Starsphere formed, but it must have been Hubble's decision.
units.displayText: I don't know the principles under which this Starsphere formed, but it must have been Hubble's decision.

spans.text: I don't know the principles under which this Starsphere formed, but it must have been Hubble's decision.

units.rawText: Even if that thing is an Entropic, that's still Hubble. She's still alive!
units.displayText: Even if that thing is an Entropic, that's still Hubble. She's still alive!

spans.text: Even if that thing is an Entropic, that's still Hubble. She's still alive!

units.rawText: Get a grip, Fresnel!
units.displayText: Get a grip, Fresnel!

spans.text: Get a grip, Fresnel!

units.rawText: We know all too well the influence of Entropization. Such conclusions we have, we reached through the loss of countless friends.
units.displayText: We know all too well the influence of Entropization. Such conclusions we have, we reached through the loss of countless friends.

spans.text: We know all too well the influence of Entropization. Such conclusions we have, we reached through the loss of countless friends.

units.rawText: If that really is Hubble, she wouldn't be the one we know. You know that well, do you not?
units.displayText: If that really is Hubble, she wouldn't be the one we know. You know that well, do you not?

spans.text: If that really is Hubble, she wouldn't be the one we know. You know that well, do you not?

units.rawText: That being said, Fresnel's ideas aren't unreasonable.
units.displayText: That being said, Fresnel's ideas aren't unreasonable.

spans.text: That being said, Fresnel's ideas aren't unreasonable.

units.rawText: What does that mean?
units.displayText: What does that mean?

spans.text: What does that mean?

units.rawText: We've never communicated with Entropized Agents that weren't under control, but we have had many exchanges with Greater Entropics.
units.displayText: We've never communicated with Entropized Agents that weren't under control, but we have had many exchanges with Greater Entropics.

spans.text: We've never communicated with Entropized Agents that weren't under control, but we have had many exchanges with Greater Entropics.

units.rawText: Do you recall the form the Greater Entropics appeared to us in? They can be communicated with, and maybe they even possess comparatively high intelligence.
units.displayText: Do you recall the form the Greater Entropics appeared to us in? They can be communicated with, and maybe they even possess comparatively high intelligence.

spans.text: Do you recall the form the Greater Entropics appeared to us in? They can be communicated with, and maybe they even possess comparatively high intelligence.

units.rawText: That's true. They clearly do have differences in intelligence within their ranks, but they are a cut above the rabble.
units.displayText: That's true. They clearly do have differences in intelligence within their ranks, but they are a cut above the rabble.

spans.text: That's true. They clearly do have differences in intelligence within their ranks, but they are a cut above the rabble.

units.rawText: We can't be sure what the structure of this Starsphere exactly is, but it clearly has something greater than a normal Entropic at its helm.
units.displayText: We can't be sure what the structure of this Starsphere exactly is, but it clearly has something greater than a normal Entropic at its helm.

spans.text: We can't be sure what the structure of this Starsphere exactly is, but it clearly has something greater than a normal Entropic at its helm.

units.rawText: If it operates in a manner similar to the Entropics we've previously encountered... then there is a nonzero chance we will be able to communicate with this "Hubble".
units.displayText: If it operates in a manner similar to the Entropics we've previously encountered... then there is a nonzero chance we will be able to communicate with this "Hubble".

spans.text: If it operates in a manner similar to the Entropics we've previously encountered... then there is a nonzero chance we will be able to communicate with this "Hubble".

units.rawText: ...We cannot deny that possibility.
units.displayText: ...We cannot deny that possibility.

spans.text: ...We cannot deny that possibility.

units.rawText: Antonina taps at the control panel in front of her, apparently entering some sort of tracking command, sighing with fatigue afterwards.
units.displayText: Antonina taps at the control panel in front of her, apparently entering some sort of tracking command, sighing with fatigue afterwards.

spans.text: Antonina taps at the control panel in front of her, apparently entering some sort of tracking command, sighing with fatigue afterwards.

units.rawText: Seriously... don't make me out to be some sort of distant, emotionless antagonist.
units.displayText: Seriously... don't make me out to be some sort of distant, emotionless antagonist.

spans.text: Seriously... don't make me out to be some sort of distant, emotionless antagonist.

units.rawText: My original plan was to get you to collect the data fragments Hubble's left behind in that Starsphere, and try to reproduce her Neural Model.
units.displayText: My original plan was to get you to collect the data fragments Hubble's left behind in that Starsphere, and try to reproduce her Neural Model.

spans.text: My original plan was to get you to collect the data fragments Hubble's left behind in that Starsphere, and try to reproduce her Neural Model.

units.rawText: You agreed to all of that, but now there's a wrench in the works... we've gotta adjust our plans.
units.displayText: You agreed to all of that, but now there's a wrench in the works... we've gotta adjust our plans.

spans.text: You agreed to all of that, but now there's a wrench in the works... we've gotta adjust our plans.

units.rawText: <size=28>And that whole "Hubble's still alive" thing... we're just as happy about that as anyone else.</size>
units.displayText: And that whole "Hubble's still alive" thing... we're just as happy about that as anyone else.

spans.text: And that whole "Hubble's still alive" thing... we're just as happy about that as anyone else.

units.rawText: I heard that.
units.displayText: I heard that.

spans.text: I heard that.

units.rawText: Well I'll have to ask you to pretend you didn't.
units.displayText: Well I'll have to ask you to pretend you didn't.

spans.text: Well I'll have to ask you to pretend you didn't.

units.rawText: Now that we've confirmed that this region's owner is "Hubble", I will try to track her movements as well. No matter what, we should locate her first, and plan from there.
units.displayText: Now that we've confirmed that this region's owner is "Hubble", I will try to track her movements as well. No matter what, we should locate her first, and plan from there.

spans.text: Now that we've confirmed that this region's owner is "Hubble", I will try to track her movements as well. No matter what, we should locate her first, and plan from there.

units.rawText: I'll be counting on you then, Antonina. The Hubble we have now is important to me, in many ways.
units.displayText: I'll be counting on you then, Antonina. The Hubble we have now is important to me, in many ways.

spans.text: I'll be counting on you then, Antonina. The Hubble we have now is important to me, in many ways.

units.rawText: When we met just then, she didn't do anything hostile. It shouldn't be too difficult to communicate when we next meet.
units.displayText: When we met just then, she didn't do anything hostile. It shouldn't be too difficult to communicate when we next meet.

spans.text: When we met just then, she didn't do anything hostile. It shouldn't be too difficult to communicate when we next meet.

units.rawText: Of course, we should also prepare for the worst.
units.displayText: Of course, we should also prepare for the worst.

spans.text: Of course, we should also prepare for the worst.

units.rawText: I do hope that it goes smoothly. I... Jiutian will support you with all we have.
units.displayText: I do hope that it goes smoothly. I... Jiutian will support you with all we have.

spans.text: I do hope that it goes smoothly. I... Jiutian will support you with all we have.

units.rawText: I did not experience that united frontline seeing as I have been reset, but Hubble's sacrifice has given us more hope.
units.displayText: I did not experience that united frontline seeing as I have been reset, but Hubble's sacrifice has given us more hope.

spans.text: I did not experience that united frontline seeing as I have been reset, but Hubble's sacrifice has given us more hope.

units.rawText: To Hubble, to the Oasis, we cannot spurn those who have given us their aid.
units.displayText: To Hubble, to the Oasis, we cannot spurn those who have given us their aid.

spans.text: To Hubble, to the Oasis, we cannot spurn those who have given us their aid.

units.rawText: Are we at a mutual understanding, then?
units.displayText: Are we at a mutual understanding, then?

spans.text: Are we at a mutual understanding, then?

units.displayText: I look towards Fresnel, whose emotions appear to have settled somewhat.

spans.text: I look towards Fresnel, whose emotions appear to have settled somewhat.

units.rawText: ...Yeah, I understand. To the Hubble we have now, we might not be much help.
units.displayText: ...Yeah, I understand. To the Hubble we have now, we might not be much help.

spans.text: ...Yeah, I understand. To the Hubble we have now, we might not be much help.

units.rawText: But the situation we're in is much better than what we originally expected, isn't that right?
units.displayText: But the situation we're in is much better than what we originally expected, isn't that right?

spans.text: But the situation we're in is much better than what we originally expected, isn't that right?

units.rawText: At least she didn't come out of the gate swinging. Though, that was never Hubble's style, was it?
units.displayText: At least she didn't come out of the gate swinging. Though, that was never Hubble's style, was it?

spans.text: At least she didn't come out of the gate swinging. Though, that was never Hubble's style, was it?

units.displayText: Hehe... no matter what's happened, Hubble is still Hubble.

units.displayText: Squeal?

units.displayText: The miniature Entropic clambers onto the control panel again, extending a tendril towards Fresnel's face, her countenance bearing a rare smile.

units.displayText: Whoa!?

units.rawText: Don't muck around!
units.displayText: Don't muck around!

units.rawText: Ignore that little guy for now. Anyway, I'm still tracking down Hubble's exact coordinates. Besides, we aren't sure exactly what state she's in right now...

units.rawText: Give it a rest, we'll see each other again soon enough! Even if you can't do anything to help out this time, at least—

units.displayText: In a gloomy place, a familiar yet strange figure is faintly discernable.

units.rawText: The spaceship evades the attack at an odd angle, the previous attacks clearing the way for us. Far behind the spaceship, the asteroid belt we previously passed through falls victim, asteroids many times the size of the spaceship fully punctured.

units.displayText: Good work, Fresnel, now we—

units.rawText: I knew it! If that's the case... full speed ahead!
units.displayText: I knew it! If that's the case... full speed ahead!

units.rawText: A black hole!
units.displayText: A black hole!

units.rawText: I crank up the spaceship's secondary boosters. Like a loosed arrow we sail forth, toward a long-awaited reunion.

units.rawText: The distance shrinks and the image in front of us enlarges. As we escape the black hole, we fly towards an old friend who knew us not, to uphold our end of a bargain we agreed upon the day the Oasis was created.
